name: Ziaur Rahman
role: Sector Commander and Z Force Commander
contribution: He broadcast the declaration of independence from Kalurghat on behalf of Sheikh Mujibur Rahman and later commanded Sector 1, Sector 11, and Z Force in combat operations.
context: Chittagong and multiple fronts during the Liberation War, 1971.
impact: His radio broadcast gave early symbolic visibility to the independence call, while his sector and force commands contributed to organized military resistance.
highlight: A battlefield commander with major symbolic wartime visibility.
seoDescription: Ziaur Rahman was a Liberation War sector commander and Z Force leader who broadcast the declaration of independence from Kalurghat on behalf of Sheikh Mujibur Rahman.
shortAnswer: A Liberation War sector commander and Z Force leader associated with the Kalurghat broadcast of the declaration of independence.

faq.question: How is Ziaur Rahman connected to 1971?
faq.answer: Ziaur Rahman is linked to the Liberation War through the project timeline as Sector Commander and Z Force Commander. He announced the declaration of independence over radio at Kalurghat and later commanded Sector 1, Sector 11, and Z Force in combat.
